materiality.rationale: Meta's first true frontier push: agentic family with explicit memory/focus mechanisms (Active Memory/Focus defined, not slogans), Prometheus-scale training, and an OOD-generalization claim tied to base-model strength. Reader learns where Meta competes (agents/memory/coding, Harvey LAB) and what remains vendor-asserted (benchmark numbers behind report link, full safety report pending). Chronology: Oct 12 announce, research blog same week. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]
